visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tortoiseshell cat with intense green eyes is seen in a close-up, vigorously scratching a light-colored, textured fabric surface on a piece of furniture. Large white text with a black outline appears in the center of the frame, posing a question about cat scratching behavior. (2) The scene cuts to an orange and white cat sitting on a light-colored floor next to a white chair leg. The chair leg is wrapped in a thick, brown, fibrous anti-scratch cloth. The cat sniffs the material curiously in a brightly lit indoor setting. (3) A calico cat is shown on a curved, brown cardboard scratching post. It is standing with its front paws extended, actively digging its claws into the corrugated texture. The background shows a wooden floor and a light-colored staircase. (4) A white cat with dark spots on its head and tail is seen on a different cardboard scratcher, which is set inside a pinkish frame. The cat is hunched over, scratching the surface with focus. Yellow text appears at the bottom. (5) The tortoiseshell cat from the first phase is now seen scratching a vertical, upright cardboard scratcher. It stands on its hind legs to reach the higher part of the scratcher. The lighting is warm and natural. (6) An orange and white cat is seen on an inclined, white-framed cardboard scratcher. It stretches its body and pulls its claws across the rough surface. The setting is a clean, modern indoor living space. (7) A dark tabby cat is briefly shown sniffing a flat cardboard scratching surface placed against a white wall. The camera angle is slightly low, looking up at the cat. (8) An orange cat is walking on a branded cardboard scratcher that has a triangular, sloped design. The cat stretches its front legs forward as it moves. The brand logo is visible on the side of the scratcher. (9) The tortoiseshell cat is shown again in a close-up, resting its head and paws on a cardboard scratcher, looking around with large eyes. The camera remains static and the lighting is consistent. (10) A white cat with black spots is seen stepping across multiple different shapes and sizes of cardboard scratchers arranged on the floor. It sniffs and interacts with the various textures before the video fades out.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR. [Variety]: 我的貓亂抓壞傢俱怎麼辦？. (2) [Subtitle]: 我新買的沙發又被貓咪抓壞了. (3) [Subtitle]: 到底為什麼貓咪那麼喜歡亂抓啦？. (4) [Subtitle]: 其實呢貓咪抓抓是他們的天性. (5) [Subtitle]: 除了能夠幫助他們運動伸展. (6) [Subtitle]: 還能磨去老化的指甲. (7) [Subtitle]: 最重要的是他們可以宣示地盤. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為貓咪的肉墊會有腺體. (9) [Subtitle]: 在磨爪的同時也會留下自己的氣味. (10) [Subtitle]: 這也是他們在告訴大家這裡是我的地盤哦！. (11) [Subtitle]: 還有抓抓的時候也能紓發情緒. (12) [Subtitle]: 太緊張、太興奮都能透過抓抓來去舒壓. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以當你回到家時你的貓咪卻突然衝去抓貓抓板. (14) [Subtitle]: 其實是釋放一整天正在等你回家的興奮感. (15) [Subtitle]: 那要怎麼樣讓貓咪不亂抓我的沙發呢？. (16) [Subtitle]: 首先大家可以去了解一下家裡貓咪磨爪習慣. (17) [Subtitle]: 像是他們對什麼材質或是什麼角度有特別的偏好. (18) [Subtitle]: 另外對於擺放位置也都會有自己的喜好喔！. (19) [Subtitle]: 所以當你的沙發常常被抓你也可以試著把沙發換一個位置. (20) [Subtitle]: 或是蓋上防貓抓的布. (21) [Subtitle]: 再來也可以根據貓咪們的喜好選購不同材質的貓抓板. (22) [Subtitle]: 放置在他們喜歡的位置也能大幅度的減少貓咪亂抓的機率哦！. (23) [Subtitle]: 我是好味小姐那你知道了嗎？
